research_evidence.normalization_reference: current-inclusive trailing percentile of the flow ratio
research_evidence.prior_condition: continuous Prior5D interaction; production hard cutoff not validated

research_evidence.entry_timing: next Taiwan trading session adjusted open (O1)
research_evidence.plain_definition: margin_sell 流量條件必須和前五日報酬交互解讀，不能單獨視為多空。
research_evidence.market_mechanism: 信用／融券流量的意義取決於先前價格路徑。
research_evidence.risks: 尚未驗證 production hard cutoff；不得計入正式票數
research_evidence.conditional_effect_description: Prior5D 越低，future effect 越正
research_evidence.representative_scope: canonical representative research row; not the full parameter grid
